title: Carbon dimer configuration
hints: Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: Eight valence electrons fill σ₂s², σ*₂s² and π₂p⁴. The order is $(6-2)/2=2$ and electrons are paired.
statement:
What does the introductory MO diagram predict for $\ce{C2}$?

[_]{a}

explanations: Both bonding π orbitals are filled.
This fails to account for full π occupation.
The 2p sigma level is empty in the early order.
This resembles the simplified B₂ prediction.
